data.name: Biosorra
data.description: Biosorra is a female-led Kenyan biochar pure-play operating what it describes as the largest industrial biochar facility in East Africa, based in Murang'a/Thika. It transforms tropical crop waste into Biochar Bora sold to smallholder farmers and Kenya Nut Company while issuing biochar carbon removal credits. In October 2025 it raised $3.5M in seed funding to scale production.
